title: sourceLocation
description: Tracks the original source location of a test or step for inline editing support. This is a read-only property populated during test detection.

file.description: Absolute path to the source file containing this test or step.

startLine.description: 1-based line number where this test or step starts.

endLine.description: 1-based line number where this test or step ends.

startColumn.description: 1-based column number where this test or step starts on startLine.

endColumn.description: 1-based column number where this test or step ends on endLine.

startOffset.description: 0-based character offset from the beginning of the file where this test or step starts.

endOffset.description: 0-based character offset from the beginning of the file where this test or step ends.

originalText.description: The original text content of this test or step as found in the source file.

isInline.description: Whether this test or step was detected from inline comments within a content file (true) or from a standalone spec file (false).

isAutoDetected.description: Whether this step was auto-detected from markup patterns (true) or explicitly defined in an inline comment (false). Only applicable to steps.

commentFormat.description: The comment format used for this inline test or step. Used when serializing edits back to the source file.
